csv_scope_of_work: The intent of this Request for Qualifications ( RFQ ) is to create a pool of pre-qualified Engineering and Architectural Service firms from which the County of Mercer will enter open- ended contracts on an as needed basis.

title: As-Needed Mercer County Engineering and Architectural Services
short_description: RFQ for an on-call pool of engineering and architectural service firms.
project_scope: Creation of a pre-qualified pool of firms for open-ended, as-needed county assignments. Requested disciplines include architecture services, interior design and space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering. No specific project, building size, structural system, span, or construction volume is defined.
services: On-call engineering and architectural services under open-ended contracts; disciplines requested: architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation/refurbishment, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style as-needed RFQ without a defined technical project scope.
- Target market is general building, not a specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, tower, or special structure.
- Includes rehabilitation and refurbishment rather than clearly defined new structurally demanding works.
- No information on spans, gross floor area, structural complexity, sustainability, or innovation.
- Falls under low-interest framework/on-call procurement with broad disciplines and no concrete structural planning opportunity visible.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for pre-qualification of on-call professional services and does not define any individual project budgets, sizes, or quantities. Therefore no realistic project-specific construction cost estimate is possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice establishes a pool for as-needed open-ended contracts with unspecified future task orders, so no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Firms are to be pre-qualified for as-needed engineering and architectural services in the requested disciplines: architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation/refurbishment, and civil engineering. No detailed reference thresholds or qualification counts are provided in the source text.
